thought.title: N-Tiling Enables Large Row Width: 2.9x Speedup at 29568
thought.description: Added N-dimension tiling when row width exceeds UB budget. TILE_N_MAX=8192 splits large rows (29568) into 4 tiles. Each tile: 8K*12B=96KB UB (inputs+cast+compute), well within 256KB. This eliminated UB overflow crash on S4. The tiling overhead (~4 iterations per row) is offset by the inherent compute efficiency for wide rows.
thought.reason: Without N-tiling, the kernel crashes with "ub address out of bounds" on N=29568 because 4 buffers × 29568 elements × (2+4) bytes = ~295KB exceeds 256KB UB. The tiled approach trades iteration count for correctness and safety.
